description: This Lantmäteriet product gives predefined building datasets for each Swedish municipality, structured to the EU INSPIRE specification for buildings. Each building has an object identity, version date, status, year of construction and extension, the property it belongs to, its footprint geometry, name and purpose. After ordering, the user gets a login to a download site served as an Atom feed, which browsers or feed readers can open. Coverage: all of Sweden, selected by municipality. Access: free, but use is checked legally under the real property register act and the GDPR, and the user must accept special terms before a login is issued; delivered in GML in SWEREF 99 TM and ETRS89, updated twice a year. Licence: terms of use for high-value datasets that contain personal data. Caveats: the approval step and personal-data terms limit redistribution; attributes are those of INSPIRE, without heights. Simulation uses are national building footprints with use and age for flood, storm and heat exposure models in Sweden. Related records: the Boverket energy declarations API.
